main.description: Return a kubeconfig for the named cluster of the calling account. Creates on read: if the account has no cluster of this name, this call creates the account workspace, its home, the Cluster record (spec.running=false) and the mounted child, then returns a kubeconfig. Idempotent - a second call finds everything and returns the same thing. Requires a service-auth JWT from the CALLER's own PDS; the account is the VERIFIED token's iss and is never read from this input. A COLD cluster is NOT an error here: the kubeconfig is returned and its mount answers 503 until controlPlaneUp is called. This call does not wake the control plane.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account. RFC-1123 label, <=63 characters.

kubeconfig.description: The whole kubeconfig, as YAML text. Its server MUST be https:// or client-go silently drops the exec credential plugin, and its exec.env carries the per-cluster device key used to mint short-lived credentials.

instance.description: status.instance: the opaque per-materialisation generation id of the cluster this kubeconfig points at. Retain it - a cached kubeconfig whose instance no longer matches must not be reused, and a new instance exists after every gateway restart, every controlPlaneUp, and every delete-then-recreate.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record for this account. The deny is written before any deletion, so it refuses while the revocation is still propagating.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.
